items.title: 68089_John Malachi oral history interview
items.q: did a lot of hanging out with was a fellow named Kenny

ctx.x: did a lot of hanging out with was a fellow named Kenny, who at that particular time was Nancy Wilson's husband. We went and saw the Muhammad Ali fight -- I think it was one of the major fights of his career -- with Sonny Liston. There were just so many things that happened...

Anyway, after that, I flew back to Washington, and I started working in a club that was owned by a fellow named Pete Lambros, but the main attraction there was a guitarist whose name was Charlie Byrd. I worked up there for I guess the better part of two years. But while I was there, I did some other miscellaneous engagements with people, one of them being Joe Williams. I did a thing, I was back in California again with him. We were there for something like two or three weeks.
